deployment.refreshRole: Codex pulls through the connected Supermetrics connector, updates public/data.json and public/realdata.js, commits, and pushes.

facebook.reachMetric: Content viewers / Page media views unique
facebook.reachAggregationRule: Do not sum daily unique viewer rows for weekly or monthly totals. Use an exact Meta/Supermetrics range total when available, or a verified Meta Business Suite override.
facebook.newFollowersRule: Use net movement from follower snapshots: range end snapshot minus the snapshot from the day before the range starts.

tiktok.queryNote: Profile metrics currently start on 2026-06-15; video-level top content can timeout, so keep profile totals live and use filtered/smaller post queries.
